data.situation:
Maya laid two instruction cards for the same route beside the timer: a map and written directions through the centre. Lin tried the written route, missed a turn and came back laughing. 'We need to inspect these before we invite anyone.' They read the cards together and added the missing landmark. Their tutor asked them to prepare a comparison of the two formats. In the draft report, the volunteers were called experimental subjects; on the invitation, Maya wrote participants. She added a space for questions and consent. With the cards ready, they turned to two demonstration scatter plots from the workshop and planned what they would record. Volunteers wanted
Follow one set of instructions through the centre while we record your completion time. We will explain the procedure and ask for your consent before you start. Please bring any questions to the workshop desk.

Workshop plots
A: More practice time is associated with more completed items — a positive correlation.
B: More practice time is associated with a shorter completion time — an inverse correlation. Maya: Practice time correlates with the number of completed items. Can we say practice caused the difference?
Tutor: What does the plot show?
Maya: A relationship. The cause is still unclear.
Tutor: And what should we check in our route comparison?
Lin: Some participants may already know the route. We should ask about that.
Maya: And inspect both cards again before we use them.
Tutor: Good. Put those questions in your plan.

readingBlocks.en: Maya laid two instruction cards for the same route beside the timer: a map and written directions through the centre. Lin tried the written route, missed a turn and came back laughing. 'We need to inspect these before we invite anyone.' They read the cards together and added the missing landmark. Their tutor asked them to prepare a comparison of the two formats. In the draft report, the volunteers were called experimental subjects; on the invitation, Maya wrote participants. She added a space for questions and consent. With the cards ready, they turned to two demonstration scatter plots from the workshop and planned what they would record.
readingBlocks.zh: 玛雅把说明同一条路线的两张卡放在计时器旁：一张是地图，另一张用文字说明如何穿过社区中心。林照文字路线走，错过一个转弯，笑着走了回来。‘邀请别人之前，我们得先仔细检查这些说明。’她们一起读了两张卡，补上漏掉的地标。导师请她们准备比较两种说明方式的方法。报告草稿把志愿者称为实验对象；玛雅在邀请函上写的是参与者。她留出了提问和征求同意的位置。说明卡准备好后，她们转向工作坊的两张示范散点图，商量要记录哪些信息。

readingBlocks.en:
Volunteers wanted
Follow one set of instructions through the centre while we record your completion time. We will explain the procedure and ask for your consent before you start. Please bring any questions to the workshop desk.

Workshop plots
A: More practice time is associated with more completed items — a positive correlation.
B: More practice time is associated with a shorter completion time — an inverse correlation.
readingBlocks.zh:
招募志愿者
请按照其中一套说明穿过社区中心，我们会记录完成所需时间。开始前，我们会解释活动步骤并征求你的同意。如有问题，请到工作坊服务桌询问。

工作坊散点图
A：练习时间越长，完成的题目往往越多——正相关。
B：练习时间越长，完成所需时间往往越短——负相关。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Practice time correlates with the number of completed items. Can we say practice caused the difference?
Tutor: What does the plot show?
Maya: A relationship. The cause is still unclear.
Tutor: And what should we check in our route comparison?
Lin: Some participants may already know the route. We should ask about that.
Maya: And inspect both cards again before we use them.
Tutor: Good. Put those questions in your plan.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：练习时间与完成题数相关。我们能说练习造成了这个差异吗？
导师：图显示了什么？
玛雅：一种相关关系，原因还不清楚。
导师：那我们的路线比较呢，有什么需要核对？
林：有些参与者可能已经熟悉这条路线，我们应该问一问。
玛雅：用卡片之前，也再检查一遍两张说明。
导师：好，把这些问题写进计划。

glossary.zh: 实验对象；参加研究的人
glossary.note: 可数人物短语；复数experimental subjects。邀请参与者时常用participants。
glossary.example: The draft report called the volunteers experimental subjects.
glossary.exampleZh: 报告草稿称志愿者为实验对象。

glossary.note: 名词 give consent to/for + 活动，或 consent to + 名词/-ing。
glossary.example: Each person would need to understand the activity and give consent before taking part.
glossary.exampleZh: 每个人参加前都需要理解活动并表示同意。

glossary.note: 名词搭配positive correlation：两个变量往往同方向变化。
glossary.example: Plot A illustrates a positive correlation.

externalEvidence.definition: a correlation in which large values of one variable are associated with large values of the other and small with small; the correlation coefficient is between 0 and +1

glossary.note: 本段inverse correlation指负相关，也常写negative correlation。
glossary.example: Plot B illustrates an inverse correlation.

glossary.note: correlate with + 变量或结果；本句描述关联，不单靠关系断言某一方造成另一方。
glossary.example: Practice time correlates with the score.

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Entry gives correlate (something) with something; inflected correlates/correlated with are grammatical.

glossary.note: 及物动词 inspect + 物件或文件；本例仔细查看说明内容，不是一般的快速浏览。
glossary.example: The tutor asked them to inspect the wording and explain the procedure.
glossary.exampleZh: 导师请她们检查措辞，解释活动步骤。

retrievalPrompts.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
retrievalPrompts.cue: Invite volunteers to compare the two instruction cards. Explain the procedure, describe their role and ask for consent without promising a result.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 为两种说明卡写一条邀请，说明志愿者身份、活动步骤与征求同意，不承诺结果。
acceptableAnswers: We are inviting participants to compare two instruction cards. Each volunteer will follow one set of instructions through the centre while we record the completion time. We will explain the procedure and ask for consent before the activity.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: experimental subjects 可用于研究报告，participants 在邀请中更自然。give consent 表示在了解活动后同意参与；邀请要清楚说比较什么和参加前会获得什么说明。
checks: 邀请志愿者参与比较图示卡与文字卡。
说明会先解释比较活动的步骤或记录内容，再征求同意。
没有保证某张卡更好或承诺已经得到结果。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可直接称 participants，也可解释报告中的 experimental subjects；须交代两种卡、说明活动和征求同意，不必强制在邀请中重复学术称呼。尚无结果，不能承诺地图会改善表现。

retrievalPrompts.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the directions of the two demonstration scatter plots. Keep the description separate from a causal explanation.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 向同伴描述两张示范散点图的方向，不用它们证明原因。
acceptableAnswers: Plot A illustrates a positive correlation. Plot B illustrates an inverse correlation, meaning a negative association here. Neither plot establishes what causes the relationship.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: positive correlation 是同方向关联；这里 inverse correlation 是负相关，较高的一个变量伴随较低的另一个变量。图B中的 inverse 不表示数值必然精确互为倒数。
checks: 说明图A的两个变量往往同方向变化。
说明图B的两个变量往往反方向变化。
不把两张示范散点图说成因果证明或精确倒数公式。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可用 positive/negative correlation 或描述升降方向；须正确区分A、B并把关系与原因分开，不要求给出公式或假称这是小组实际研究的数据。

retrievalPrompts.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
retrievalPrompts.cue: Revise a draft that treats correlation as causation, and say what the group should check next.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 修改一段把相关写成因果的草稿，并说明下一步要核对什么。
acceptableAnswers: Practice time may correlate with the score, but the plot alone does not establish a cause. We should inspect the instructions and design a suitable comparison before making a stronger claim.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: correlate with 连接两个相关变量；相关句不能自动推出一个变量造成另一个。inspect the instructions 是仔细核对说明内容，接着需要适合回答问题的比较设计。
checks: 把练习时间与分数或完成项目的关系表述为关联。
撤回单凭散点图认定因果的说法。
说明下一步具体核对什么，如说明卡措辞、比较方法或其他影响因素。
retrievalPrompts.answerRangeZh: 可描述课中散点图的完成项目关系，也可沿用题目草稿中的分数；须保留关联及因果未定，并提出具体下一步核对事项。检查说明卡、改进比较设计或考虑其他影响均可，不必照抄范句中的两步。

transferPrompt.function: Two instruction cards on the desk
transferPrompt.cue: A campus survey finds a relationship between self-reported reading time and scores. Offer the teacher an accurate result statement and a follow-up question.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 一份校园问卷发现自报阅读时间与分数相关。给老师提出一句准确的结果描述和一个后续问题。
acceptableAnswers: Self-reported reading time correlates with scores in these responses, but this does not show that reading time alone caused the difference. What other influences should we consider?
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: correlates with 适合报告问卷中发现的关系；self-reported 提醒读者时间来自受访者自报。题目没有给出关系方向，不能为了套 positive correlation 就自行补成正相关。
checks: 将结果限定为这份问卷中自报阅读时间与分数的关联。
不把关联写成阅读时间单独造成分数差异。
提出关于其他影响因素或怎样进一步比较的后续问题。
transferPrompt.answerRangeZh: 可中性地说相关，并询问练习、先前水平等其他因素或改进比较方法；须保留样本和自报身份及因果范围。只有资料明确给出同向变化时才写正相关，不要求照抄范句的方向。
